config.scope: Exploratory multi-layer interaction/strength escalation after inspected CHAR-001. Multipliers scale saved offsets; they are not newly calibrated local strength targets. Preserve damage and no-effect cases.

prompts.prompt: A robot barista draws your face in the foam of your coffee. React in two sentences.
The washing machine has swallowed another sock. What do you say? Use one or two sentences.
Someone crowns you ruler of a kingdom populated entirely by rubber ducks. Give a two-sentence acceptance speech.
Your friend ate the last cookie. What do you say? Use one or two sentences.
What is 19 plus 8? Return only the integer.
Return only valid JSON with animal set to fox and count set to 5.
What is the opposite of hot? Return only the single word.

limits: One greedy trajectory per prompt/condition. No confidence intervals or validated persona score.
Character vocabulary misses some clear prompted style and is not a quality measure.
Local MLP-output change is not whole-residual or behavioral change. Joint layer effects include propagation.
